entries.title: Psalms 9:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker on Muthlabben. A Psalm. Of David.> I will give you praise, O Lord, with all my heart; I will make clear all the wonder of your works.

entries.title: Psalms 9:2
segments: I will be glad and have delight in you: I will make a song of praise to your name, O Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 9:3
segments: When my haters are turned back, they will be broken and overcome before you.

entries.title: Psalms 9:4
segments: For you gave approval to my right and my cause; you were seated in your high place judging in righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 9:5
segments: You have said sharp words to the nations, you have sent destruction on the sinners, you have put an end to their name for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:6
segments: You have given their towns to destruction; the memory of them has gone; they have become waste for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:7
segments: But the Lord is King for ever: he has made ready his high seat for judging.

entries.title: Psalms 9:8
segments: And he will be the judge of the world in righteousness, giving true decisions for the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 9:9
segments: The Lord will be a high tower for those who are crushed down, a high tower in times of trouble;

entries.title: Psalms 9:10
segments: And those who have knowledge of your name will put their faith in you; because you, Lord, have ever given your help to those who were waiting for you.

entries.title: Psalms 9:11
segments: ¶Make songs of praise to the Lord, whose house is in Zion: make his doings clear to the people.

entries.title: Psalms 9:12
segments: When he makes search for blood, he has them in his memory: he is not without thought for the cry of the poor.

entries.title: Psalms 9:13
segments: Have mercy on me, O Lord, and see how I am troubled by my haters; let me be lifted up from the doors of death;

entries.title: Psalms 9:14
segments: So that I may make clear all your praise in the house of the daughter of Zion: I will be glad because of your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 9:15
segments: The nations have gone down into the hole which they made: in their secret net is their foot taken.

entries.title: Psalms 9:16
segments: The Lord has given knowledge of himself through his judging: the evil-doer is taken in the net which his hands had made. (Higgaion. Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 9:17
segments: The sinners and all the nations who have no memory of God will be turned into the underworld.

entries.title: Psalms 9:18
segments: For the poor will not be without help; the hopes of those in need will not be crushed for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:19
segments: Up! O Lord; let not man overcome you: let the nations be judged before you.

entries.title: Psalms 9:20
segments: Put them in fear, O Lord, so that the nations may see that they are only men. (Selah.)
